reply.observation: While I held the cup near the person's right hand, they pointed to the tabletop in front of them. I moved the cup toward that spot.
reply.interpretation: The gesture suggested they wanted me to set the drink down where they pointed.
reply.title: Drink placement
reply.note: On this occasion, the person indicated a spot on the table when I offered their drink.
reply.question: For future drinks, would you like me to set the cup on the table in front of you?
